ul: الماضي المستمر [[was/were + v-ing]] لحدث كان مستمر: [[I was studying at 8 p.m.]]
[[when]] + ماضي بسيط (حدث قصير) و[[while]] + ماضي مستمر (حدث طويل): [[While I was running, I fell down.]]
[[used to + verb]] لعادة في الماضي انتهت: [[I used to be afraid of the dark.]]

check.q: [[I ...... my homework when the lights went out.]]
[[He ...... play with toys, but now he reads books.]]

q.q: [[They ...... live in Cairo, but now they live in Dubai.]]
[[I have seen this film last week.]] جملة صحيحة.
q.e: مع last week نستخدم الماضي: I saw.

q.q: [[She was reading when I arrived.]] جملة صحيحة.
